title: antillanthus pachypodus
intro: Antillanthus pachypodus, commonly known as Rockrose, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help protect against chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Antillanthus pachypodus include its antimicrobial and antiseptic properties, making it useful for wound healing and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
